description: This file defines classes and structures for database connection management, including DatabaseTable, DatabaseRow, DatabaseColumnEntry, DatabaseQuery, and DatabaseConnection, with methods for connecting, executing queries, and retrieving results.
external_methods: DatabaseInterface functions (not explicitly listed in the file but included via header)

classes.name: DatabaseTable
classes.description: Represents a table of database rows, providing methods to add and access rows and columns.

classes.name: DatabaseRow
classes.description: Represents a single row in a database table, containing multiple column entries.

classes.name: DatabaseColumnEntry
classes.description: Represents a single column entry with a name and value within a database row.

classes.name: DatabaseQuery
classes.description: Encapsulates a database query string and the target database name.

classes.name: DatabaseConnection
classes.description: Manages a connection to a database, including connecting, disconnecting, executing queries, and retrieving results.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the specified database.

methods.name: ExecAndGetModified
methods.description: Executes a query and retrieves the number of modified rows.

methods.name: ExecAndGetResults
methods.description: Executes a query and retrieves the results into a DatabaseTable.

methods.name: GetDatabaseName
methods.description: Returns the name of the connected database.

methods.name: IsConnected
methods.description: Checks if the database connection is active.

methods.name: DbCallbackOnly
methods.description: Static callback function for database operations (implementation not shown).

methods.name: DbCallbackGetResults
methods.description: Static callback function for retrieving query results (implementation not shown).
